# flowdraft

> flowdraft (https://flowdraft.tech) is a free online flowchart editor that runs in the browser on desktops, phones and tablets. You can start drawing without an account; a free account adds cloud save and auto-save. Diagrams export to PNG, SVG and JSON. AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code can draw and edit a user's diagrams through the flowdraft MCP server at https://flowdraft.tech/mcp. The interface is available in Turkish and English. (Türkçe: flowdraft, tarayıcıda ve telefonda çalışan ücretsiz bir akış diyagramı editörüdür.)

Good for: process maps, business workflows, automation and integration flows, chatbot and conversation flows, approval flows with human-in-the-loop steps, and swimlane diagrams.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No account needed to draw; sign-in (free) is only needed to save to the cloud, export and auto-save.
- Platforms: any modern web browser; installable as a PWA. An iPad app is in preparation.
- Building blocks: step, highlighted step, human approval, decision, start/end, person, bot, system, database, chat bubble, note/info/warning/error/success callouts, swimlane, automation zone, heading, chip.
- Connections: solid, dashed or dotted; 6 colors; stepped, curved or straight paths; arrow direction; flow animation; labels.
- Export: PNG image, SVG vector, editable JSON.
- Storage: projects are stored only as node and edge JSON; no image uploads.

Each page is available in Turkish (`?lang=tr`) and English (`?lang=en`).

## Guides

Plain HTML articles (no JavaScript needed) with example diagrams that open in the editor. Each Turkish page has an English counterpart.

- [What is a flowchart?](https://flowdraft.tech/what-is-a-flowchart): what a flowchart is, when to use one and how to draw it step by step
- [Akış diyagramı nedir?](https://flowdraft.tech/akis-diyagrami): the same guide in Turkish
- [Flowchart symbols](https://flowdraft.tech/flowchart-symbols): the standard flowchart shapes, what each one means and how to draw it in flowdraft
- [Akış diyagramı sembolleri](https://flowdraft.tech/akis-diyagrami-sembolleri): flowchart symbols in Turkish
- [Flowchart examples](https://flowdraft.tech/flowchart-examples): ready-made flowchart examples for algorithms, business processes and daily tasks, each one editable
- [Akış diyagramı örnekleri](https://flowdraft.tech/akis-diyagrami-ornekleri): flowchart examples in Turkish
- [Make a flowchart with ChatGPT or Claude](https://flowdraft.tech/chatgpt-flowchart): drawing and editing flowcharts with AI assistants over MCP
- [Yapay zekâ ile akış diyagramı](https://flowdraft.tech/yapay-zeka-ile-akis-diyagrami): AI flowcharts with ChatGPT and Claude, in Turkish

## MCP server (for AI assistants)

- Endpoint: `https://flowdraft.tech/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). Opening it in a browser shows the setup guide.
- Authentication: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; the user signs in to flowdraft and approves access.
- Tools: `list_diagrams`, `get_diagram`, `create_diagram`, `update_diagram`, `delete_diagram`, `get_open_diagram`. Each works only on the signed-in user's own diagrams.
- `create_diagram`, `update_diagram`, `get_diagram` and `get_open_diagram` return a PNG of the diagram, drawn on the server, which MCP Apps hosts (Claude, ChatGPT) show in the chat: users can draw and revise flows entirely from the chat.
- `get_open_diagram` returns the canvas the user has open in flowdraft right now, unsaved edits included.
- Tool results include a `https://flowdraft.tech/?p=<id>` link that opens the diagram in the editor.
